environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Admission enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. Pod securityContext specifies allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, runAsNonRoot: true, and drops ALL capabilities then adds back only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Additionally, an Istio service mesh sidecar (v1.20) is injected with AuthorizationPolicy requiring valid mTLS peer identity, and the sidecar's EnvoyFilter applies a Lua script that inspects outbound HTTP traffic on port 8080 for CRLF sequences (\r\n) in any header value, returning 403 if detected. The container image is built with a distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/python3) which does NOT include socat or any shell utilities.

config.installed_binaries: python3 only, no socat, no shell
